description: Market-level rows, one per date, point in time: US equity market regime (market_*) and economy (macro_*) bands and values, e.g. market_regime_zone, macro_yield_curve_zone. changes=true returns only dates where a band changed. Field list: get_schema level=market. To find tickers under a regime, put market_/macro_ filters into query.

append.description: Add rows to an existing store_as table instead of replacing it.

changes.description: true, or a JSON array of bands to watch.

fetch_all.description: Follow every page into store_as in this one call.

fields.description: JSON array of market fields; ["*"] adds change markers.

filters.description: JSON array of {field, op, value} on market fields.

store_as.description: Table name: store rows in SQLite, return only a summary. Read with query_data.

timeframe.description: Default: daily (every plan reads daily and weekly).

name: get_market
